svg.title: Jev Gate dashboard
svg.desc: Animated sample of the Jev Gate dashboard, with sample data. Jev calls travel from the gate stages and the Router, Compact and Evidence nodes down a dashed wire to the Jev 1.14 rail and back; each returning dot carries its response time, flashes its node and updates the node value, its execution row, the 30-second response timeline and the Jev call log with its decision basis. Tool guard, Plan and Worker records land without a Jev call.
svg.text: Select a node to gather that feature
Inspect this execution and its evidence ↗
Select a row to pin its decision basis
